name: qa-time
text:
**PASS.** The time-worked fix meets all six acceptance criteria. `bh check` passes all 127 tests on the staged tree. Nothing in the mod still works out a duration from `started`.

I checked the overlap maths by hand: overlapping, nested, touching and unsorted turns all add up correctly, and turns with a missing or bad `ms` or `at` are skipped. If an agent dies, the live part stops, because the rail drops that agent's `since` entry. I added no tests, since `test/worked.test.mjs` and `test/steps.test.mjs` already cover each criterion.

Two minor findings, neither blocking:
- **Live part matched by agent name** (`chat.js:664`, `steps.js:78`): if two active steps have an agent with the same name, such as `dev`, both trackers add the live part when either agent works. Fix: match on the agent's address instead of its name.
- **Task total leaves out the live part** (`steps.js:83`): during a turn, the step's time can read higher than the task's total until that turn is recorded.

There are also four info notes in the report. One is that `step: null` records count in the task total but in no step, as the contract says.

The verdict is recorded with `bh gate`, the step 3 report is filed, and t50 has been sent the summary. Report: `.bot-herdr/tasks/t-20261114-gd43/reports/qa-gate.md`, with the same content in `qa-time.md`.
